# Wave

Wave is a team of audio-industry veterans producing custom, expert-annotated audio datasets for AI teams: supervised labels (tasks, traces, captions, attributes, corrections, segment-level annotation) co-designed to your spec.

## Blog

- [Can AI judge music quality? What the data says in 2026](https://wave-hq.com/blog/can-ai-judge-music-quality/): AI judges reach 60–70% agreement with human experts on music quality, below the ~75% rate at which experts agree with each other. Covers evaluation metrics (FAD, KAD, MAD, CLAP), benchmarks (SongEval, MusicEval, Music Arena), trained judge models (Audiobox Aesthetics, reward models), and human listening-test practice (MOS, MUSHRA).
- [Can user feedback replace expert labels for audio AI? What the data says](https://wave-hq.com/blog/user-feedback-vs-expert-labels/): When user-preference signals (Google's MusicRL, 300k preferences) suffice versus when expert annotation is required for audio AI. Covers crowd votes vs expert labels, arena leaderboards vs expert judgment, expert agreement (~75%, CMI-RewardBench), preference bias, and the tuning-vs-capability line.
- [Who should label your audio data? Crowd platforms, data vendors, and expert teams compared (2026)](https://wave-hq.com/blog/audio-annotation-options-compared/): Neutral comparison of crowd marketplaces (Mercor, Alignerr, Outlier), managed vendors (Appen, iMerit, TELUS, Sama), speech-data specialists (David AI), expert audio teams, and in-house for labeling audio data, with documented 2026 rates ($4–54/hr) and quality/QA guidance (inter-annotator agreement, gold sets).
